name: Olive oil, extra virgin
storage: Keep tightly closed in a cool, dark cupboard, away from the stove; use within about 3 months of opening for best flavour. Do not refrigerate (it clouds, harmlessly).
looksLike: A pale gold to green liquid oil sold in glass or plastic bottles and tins; extra virgin has a fruity, slightly peppery smell.
howToPick: For "extra virgin" look for the words on the label, a harvest or best-before date and a dark glass bottle or tin. Avoid a rancid, crayon-like smell or a bottle kept in a sunny shop window. Use plain "pure" or "extra light" for high-heat frying and extra virgin for sauces and finishing.
shelfLife: Usually 18 to 24 months sealed, shorter once opened (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
mergeNotes: Range 855.0–1500.0 was wider than 30% of avg 1195.0; narrowed to ±15%.
